custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'floating' appearance of some speakers. Verify if the stands physically support the weight or if they seem to merge into the cabinet. Also, check the symmetry of the circular drivers; AI often generates slightly oval or irregular circles for speaker cones.
